content.text:
**Finding: compliant (no redline).**

Section 9.4 hits our preferred position on every material term — Customer convenience termination of the Agreement or any Order Form (whole or partial) on 30 days' written notice, pro-rata refund of prepaid Fees, no early-termination fee, and an express statement that Vendor has no reciprocal convenience right during a committed term. I checked the rest of the termination architecture (§§ 9.1–9.5, 10.1–10.2, 24.4, 27.3) and found no Vendor convenience right and no exit penalty; § 24.4 additionally blocks Vendor from terminating on our change of control.

One cross-reference noted but not flagged here: § 2.1's three-year take-or-pay commitment "without reduction or termination rights" cuts against § 9.4, and should be addressed under the minimum-commitment rule rather than double-flagged under T4C.
